==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I struggle to remember my dream, unaware that I am still dreaming.
I tell a bully that he won't be remembered and he evaporates away. This makes me lucid as I will myself into sleep paralysis.
I summon a cosmic key and travel to a storm world. I feast on lightning and relax in the rain.
